page_convention: Physical 1-based PDF pages, NOT printed page numbers (physical page 36 shows printed '35'). Pages with no extractable text are skipped, so numbering has gaps.

labelling.primary_pages: Evidence that MUST be retrieved. Drives Page Recall.
labelling.acceptable_pages: Genuinely supporting evidence. Not counted as false positives in Adjusted Page Precision.
